description_en: Removes IP addresses from the blacklist of an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 删除针对DDoS高防实例的黑名单IP
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo delete-auto-cc-blacklist --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --blacklist src_:_198.51.XX.XX_,_src_:_198.52.XX.XX --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAutoCcBlacklist

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
A JSON string that contains the IP addresses to remove from the blacklist. The string has the following structure:

src: The IP address to remove. This is a required string
parameters.help_zh:
黑名单IP的详细信息，使用JSON格式的字符串表述，具体结构如下。
src：String类型，必选，黑名单IP
parameters.name: blacklist

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
